== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Heralds are a high-level rank of [[sacred artists]] situated between [[Sages]] and [[Monarchs]]. Unlike [[Sages]], who focus their [[willpower]] externally to influence the world, Heralds focus their power inwardly to enhance their own physical and spiritual capabilities. This process results in the merging of their [[spirit]] and body into a single entity, allowing them to shift between physical and spiritual forms at will. While this makes them incredibly robust and powerful, it also renders them unable to perceive the subtle truths of [[Icons]] that [[Sages]] can readily access; essentially, Heralds are described as being 'inside' themselves, making them deaf to external spiritual nuances. In terms of power and role, Heralds represent a significant portion of global military strength. They serve various functions across the world: some act as guardians protecting human civilization from threats in the [[Wasteland]], others serve as high-ranking members of powerful organizations like [[Redmoon Hall]] or [[Abyssal Palace]], and some act as the right hands to kings. They are capable of immense feats, such as looting entire facilities or engaging in battles that could potentially destroy pocket worlds. Despite their immense strength, Heralds are not invincible; they can be vulnerable to attacks from those with sufficient will and may face significant physical or spiritual instability if they attempt to advance through the ranks too quickly, potentially becoming incomplete pseudo-Heralds.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Throughout the conflict, many Heralds expressed unusual observations regarding the [[Ninecloud team]]. While they typically avoid engaging in open combat, moving large numbers of these entities incurs a significant cost. Their involvement is tied to the outcome of [[Mercy]]'s struggle, as a victory would demonstrate that the [[Akura clan]] surpasses the Gold dragons{{!}}gold dragons in strength; conversely, they would kill both [[Fury]] and [[Mercy]] should [[Yerin]] suffer a defeat. As beings that are only half spirits, Heralds combine with their [[Remnants]] and have historically been identified by wearing red badges. Despite their power, they might choose not to interfere with a single [[Underlord]] operating within their territory.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">9</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Many [[Heralds]] have made strange comments about the [[Ninecloud team]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c3">''Wintersteel'', chapter 3</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|A victory for [[Mercy]] would show the [[Heralds]] that the [[Akura clan]] is stronger than the Gold dragons{{!}}gold dragons.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c16">''Wintersteel'', chapter 16</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Heralds]] do not engage in open blows.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c18">''Wintersteel'', chapter 18</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Moving many [[Heralds]] has a cost.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c18" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Heralds]] would kill [[Fury]] and [[Mercy]] if [[Yerin]] loses.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c22">''Wintersteel'', chapter 22</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Heralds]] might not interfere with one [[Underlord]] running around while in their grip.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c25">''Wintersteel'', chapter 25</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Heralds]] are only half spirits.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c26">''Wintersteel'', chapter 26</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Heralds]] combine with their [[Remnants]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c26" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Heralds]] historically wore badges of red.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c28">''Wintersteel'', chapter 28</ref>}}</li>
